chats.answer:
If you're looking for a trail camera that connects directly to your home Wi-Fi, rather than using a cellular data plan, there are several options.

The important distinction is that many trail cameras advertised as "Wi-Fi" only connect to your phone when you're standing nearby. They cannot connect to your home router or send photos remotely.

For your use case, look for a camera that supports:

2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi and internet connectivity

Remote photo/video viewing through an app

Motion-triggered recording, including at night

Battery or solar power if you're mounting it outdoors

Trail cameras worth considering

GardePro E8 3.0 Pro

Best for direct connection to your home router. Supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, 4K recording, night vision, and remote motion alerts. No cellular plan required. Remote live streaming is not supported.
